localeCode.description: BCP 47 language tag for this locale, used as the <html lang> value.

listSeparator.description: Separator used when joining short status fragments in a sentence.

extensionName.message: Scrolling Screenshot — Full Page & In-Page Scroll Area Capture

extensionDescription.message: Capture a whole page — or a panel that scrolls inside it — as one long PNG or JPEG. Runs entirely on your device.

popupSubtitle.message: Capture this page as one long image

statusContainerDetected.message: Found an in-page scroll area, loading its content…

statusTruncating.message: This page is longer than $MAX$ screens — capturing the first $MAX$.

statusWaitingForTab.message: Waiting for you to switch back to the page being captured…

statusStitching.message: Stitching the long image and saving…

doneTruncated.message: Page exceeds the limit — captured the first $DONE$ of $TOTAL$ screens

doneStoppedEarly.message: Scrolling stopped early, the long image may be incomplete

doneFrameLimited.message: The page's main content sits in a protected embedded frame this extension can't reach, so the image may show only one screen.

donePreviewFailed.message: Preview cache failed, but the image was saved

errBusy.message: A capture is already running. Please try again in a moment.

errInternalPage.message: Built-in browser pages can't be captured. Please use this on a regular web page.

errTabSwitched.message: You stayed on another tab too long, so the capture stopped. Go back to the page and try again.

errContainerStuck.message: The detected in-page scroll area won't scroll — it may be the wrong region. Scroll the content you want with your mouse wheel first, then capture again.

errPageStuck.message: The page won't scroll. Its content may still be loading, or scrolling is disabled.

errPortLost.message: The capture was interrupted. Please try again.

viewerEmptyCacheFailed.message: Couldn't read the preview cache. Go back to the page, capture again, then reopen this.

viewerEmptyNoImages.message: No image to show. Go back to the page, capture again, then reopen this.
